Principle 16: Korean Culture
Korea’s History
Korea has a long, rich, and colorful history that is over five thousand years old.
We are proud of our history and culture.
Entertainment in Korea
Today’s youth like musicians, singers, and actors.
It is very different from our generation.
Because our generation likes movies and television dramas, entertainers are our modern heroes.
Now, more young people are becoming addicted to computer games, which are slowly deteriorating their minds.
Popular Sports in Korea
After the 2002 Soccer World Cup was held in Korea, soccer and many other sports became more popular in our country.
On weekends, we mostly watch sports or go to live games at the stadium.
Nowadays, rollerblading and skate boarding are becoming popular with Korean children.
Korean Films
The film industry in Korea is really booming these days.
Our films are exported all over Asia, and our actors are becoming famous.
This is very good for the Korean economy.
Korean people also enjoy watching films from all over the world.
The Health of Koreans
Because of the slow rise in obesity in Korea today, many Koreans are becoming more interested in their health and try to exercise regularly in order to stay in shape.
Some people go to health clubs, attend exercise classes, mountain climb, or swim.
When we are active, we stay healthier.
When we are healthier, we can live longer and happier lives.
